keyQuestions.text: Can iOS touch/click dispatch interact badly with the synchronous remove/recreate/refresh sequence, overlay pointerdown capture, or stale handlers?
keyQuestions.disposition: high-fit stale-target seam; device trace required to prove retargeting or duplicate dispatch

keyQuestions.text: Can same-frame class swaps, transition cancellation, or missing transitionend leave the rebuilt sheet in a visually or interactively broken state?
Can VisualViewport, keyboard, safe-area, or body-portal geometry updates move or cover the new sheet during the action?
keyQuestions.disposition: high-fit conditional timing and ownership risk; settle-and-generation trace required

keyQuestions.text: Can WebKit gesture arbitration, overscroll, touch-action, passive-listener behavior, or Obsidian's own modal layers swallow or redirect the tap?
Can focus, scrollIntoView, the custom dropdown/listbox, 100vh/svh, or safe-area handling cause the post-add freeze/jump?
keyQuestions.disposition: custom active-option focus plus scrollIntoView is strongest post-add follow-up trigger; delayed input focus and viewport units are amplifiers

keyFindings.diagnostic: Focus/blur/activeElement trace with panel generation and preventScroll comparison
keyFindings.fix: Preserve the invoking control when possible; use focus({preventScroll:true}) only for intentional panel focus and restore focus by generation

keyFindings.label: Custom active-option focus plus scrollIntoView is the strongest post-add viewport trigger
keyFindings.diagnostic: Trace focus target, scrollIntoView options, scrollTop/scrollHeight, VisualViewport geometry and long tasks after the new-row option opens
keyFindings.fix: Do not focus the active option on open unless keyboard navigation requires it; use preventScroll and bounded local scrolling; defer until the new panel settles

keyFindings.label: Searchable dropdown schedules a next-task input focus that can open the keyboard
keyFindings.diagnostic: Mark Add, dropdown-open, setTimeout, input-focus, keyboardInset and VisualViewport events on one monotonic timeline
keyFindings.fix: Make autofocus explicit and user-intent gated; cancel delayed focus on teardown; place after a settled viewport sample

keyFindings.label: svh/safe-area CSS and JS innerHeight can disagree during keyboard or host chrome changes
keyFindings.diagnostic: Record env-safe-area, computed max-height, rect bottom, innerHeight, visualViewport height/offset and keyboard inset across four stable frames
keyFindings.fix: Choose one viewport contract per surface; avoid mixing stale innerHeight with dynamic CSS unit assumptions and clamp inset once per settled frame

keyFindings.label: Obsidian mobile host focus/keyboard layers are a plausible amplifier, not repo-proven
keyFindings.diagnostic: Snapshot elementsFromPoint, composedPath, z-index, pointer-events, host modal markers and activeElement before/after focus
keyFindings.fix: Use one documented host layer, unregister old surfaces before replacement, and avoid private host selectors; confirm with runtime hit-testing
